"), a North American owner, operator and developer of renewable energy projects, reported its financial results for the year ended June 30, 2026 ("FY2026"). This earnings release should be read in conjunction with the Company's consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis, which are available on the Company's website at www.revolve-renewablepower.com and have been posted on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca. All amounts reported are in US dollars.

"FY2026 was a year of substantial investment in the next phase of Revolve's growth," said CEO Myke Clark. "We advanced construction of new distributed generation projects in Mexico, strengthened our financing platform and continued to invest in our development pipeline. Following year end, we added operating battery storage and wind assets in Canada and the United States and established long-term project-level financing for our Mexico distributed generation portfolio. These steps support our strategy of growing recurring revenue, using project-level financing and recycling capital into additional operating and development opportunities."
Key financial highlights (all figures reported in USD):

Total revenue of $2,395,384 in FY2026, compared with $3,983,226 in FY2025. FY2025 included $1,741,869 of project asset sale revenue, while FY2026 revenue was generated from electricity sales, distributed generation finance income and asset management income.
Recurring revenue from operating activities of $2,395,384, compared with $2,241,357 in FY2025, representing an increase of approximately 7%.
Gross profit of $1,636,226, representing a gross margin of approximately 68%, compared with gross profit of $3,238,341 in FY2025.
Net loss of $4,866,082, compared with a net loss of $2,590,122 in FY2025.
Cash of $3,639,716 as at June 30, 2026, compared with $1,267,082 as at June 30, 2025.
Key business highlights and subsequent events:

Banco Multiva project-level financing. On August 27, 2026, the Company announced a MXN$450 million financing facility, approximately US$24 million, for the development, construction and refinancing of distributed generation projects in Mexico. The facility comprises two MXN$225 million tranches, has a 14-year term from signing and provides financing for up to 75% of eligible project costs. The Company completed an initial drawdown of approximately MXN$128.8 million, or US$7.7 million.

Bridge credit facility. On July 31, 2026, the Company entered into an $11 million bridge credit facility with Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC, an affiliate of Callaway Capital Management LLC. The facility was fully drawn, and the proceeds were used to fund the Ontario battery storage and Horseshoe Bend acquisitions and other targeted acquisition activity.

Ontario battery storage acquisition. On August 12, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of six operating behind-the-meter battery energy storage projects in Ontario with total capacity of approximately 14.2 MW.
Horseshoe Bend wind acquisition. On September 11, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of the 9.6 MW operating Horseshoe Bend wind project in Great Falls, Montana.

On September 10, 2026, the Company acquired the remaining 10% ownership interest in MRE US Wind & Solar Inc. from Running Foxes Wind & Solar LLC for total cash consideration of $625,000. Following the completion of the transaction, the Company holds 100% of the outstanding ownership interests in MRE US Wind & Solar Inc., making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

Proposed Whitfield transaction. As announced on September 15, 2026, the Company entered into an arrangement agreement with Whitfield Power Solutions, LLC under which Whitfield agreed to acquire all the issued and outstanding common shares of the Company. Please refer to the news release dated September 15, 2026, for full details: https://revolve-renewablepower.com/revolve-and-whitfield-power-solutions-to-combine/. The proposed transaction remains subject to shareholder, court, regulatory and other customary approvals and conditions.

Revolve was formed in 2012 to capitalize on the growing global demand for renewable power. Revolve develops utility-scale wind, solar, hydro and battery storage projects in the US, Canada and Mexico. Revolve also installs and operates sub 20 megawatt ("MW") "behind the meter" distributed generation (or "DG") assets. Revolve's portfolio includes the following:
Operating Assets
: 38 MW (net) of operating assets under long term power purchase agreements across Canada and Mexico covering wind, solar, battery storage and hydro generation;
Development

: a diverse portfolio of utility scale development projects across the US, Canada and Mexico with a combined capacity of over 3,000MWs as well as a 140MW+ distributed generation portfolio that is under development.

Revolve has an accomplished management team with a demonstrated track record of taking projects from "greenfield" through to "ready to build" status and successfully concluding project sales to large operators of utility-scale renewable energy projects. To date, Revolve has developed and sold over 1,550MW of projects.

Management believes that EBITDA provides useful supplemental information regarding the expected operating performance of the Horseshoe Bend Wind Project by excluding certain expenses that may not be indicative of the Project's core operating performance.
